Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and strategic planning skills. Advanced expertise in trade compliance technology platforms, automation solutions, and digital transformation initiatives. Strong systems-thinking capabilities with the ability to influence long-term organizational direction. Exceptional relationship-building and executive communication skills. Experience representing an organization with regulatory agencies, industry associations, and external stakeholders. Recognized expertise in developing innovative compliance frameworks, methodologies, and best practices. Experience working within highly regulated manufacturing or high-technology environments.
